title: A Yorehold rules system (ruleset.json)
description: Read by rules/content/Ruleset.cs; the whole language is docs/RULES_LANGUAGE.md.

abilities.description: The numbers a character has (Fate's approaches are its abilities).

advancement.description: How characters go up: experience, milestones, or not at all.

attackPenalty.description: A formula from attacks made this turn (PF2e's multiple attack penalty).

baseDc.description: DCs and passive scores; when a trap check fumbles.

checks.description: Roll kinds (attack, check, save, initiative and any of the system's own): dice, dice with advantage and disadvantage, outcomes worst to best, the degree formula that picks one, opposed, the defence attacks meet, and criticalDamage.

companions.description: Who joins the party and how.

creation.description: The steps of making a character and the parts each picks; what parts are called.

death.description: Death saves or a dying track; the downed, dying, stable and dead conditions; what clears wounded.

defaultHitDie.description: How characters go up: experience, milestones, or not at all.

defences.description: Defences beside ac, each a formula (Fate's Defend).

featKinds.description: Kinds of feat; kinds of pick beside race and class (PF2e's heritage).

fields.description: Words a character is made of (Fate's high concept, trouble, aspects).

hitDieByClass.description: How characters go up: experience, milestones, or not at all.

id.description: a-z, 0-9, - and _; the file name without .json

modifierTable.description: How a score becomes a modifier and how scores are set.

name.description: the system's name, as players see it

optionKinds.description: Kinds of feat; kinds of pick beside race and class (PF2e's heritage).

passiveBase.description: DCs and passive scores; when a trap check fumbles.

proficiencyByLevel.description: Proficiency as a number or ranks.

proficiencyRanks.description: Proficiency as a number or ranks.

proficientRank.description: Proficiency as a number or ranks.

roles.description: Which ability or skill the game uses for initiative, HP, attacks, carrying, perception, stealth.

saves.description: Saves of their own (Fortitude, Reflex, Will) or none: abilities are saves.

scoreMax.description: How a score becomes a modifier and how scores are set.

scoreMethods.description: How a score becomes a modifier and how scores are set.

scoreMin.description: How a score becomes a modifier and how scores are set.

sharedTurns.description: Members of a side next in order pick who goes.

sheet.description: Which parts the character sheet shows, in order, and their labels.

skills.description: The numbers a character has (Fate's approaches are its abilities).

tracks.description: What harm uses up, in order (HP; Fate's stress and consequences).

trapFumble.description: DCs and passive scores; when a trap check fumbles.

turnOrder.description: One initiative order or side by side; rolled or by the modifier alone; picked: whoever acted names who's next.

turnWords.description: What the system calls an action, a bonus action, a reaction, a free action.

untrainedRank.description: Proficiency as a number or ranks.

xpForLevel.description: How characters go up: experience, milestones, or not at all.
